mapper.sql: e.emp_id, e.emp_no, e.ename, e.gender, e.email, e.phone, e.hiredate, e.photo_path, e.resign_date, e.department_id, e.job_id, e.status

where.if: and (e.ename like concat('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') or e.emp_no like concat('%', #{search.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select from emp e join job j on j.job_id = e.job_id join department d on d.department_id = e.department_id
order by case d.department_level when 1 then 0 when 2 then d.department_id else d.parent_id end, d.department_level, d.department_id, j.job_level desc, e.emp_id limit #{pager.pageSize} offset #{pager.offset}
select coalesce(max(cast(substring(emp_no, 5) as unsigned)), 0) + 1 from emp where emp_no like concat(#{year}, '____')
mapper.insert: insert into emp(emp_no, ename, gender, email, phone, hiredate, department_id, job_id, status) values(#{empNo}, #{ename}, #{gender}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{hiredate}, #{department.departmentId}, #{job.jobId}, 'ACTIVE')
